effective_policy: Applies after founder acknowledgment. Until then f34 cannot support comparative runs, scores or claims, and the acceptance of promote-referents-without-nudges PR B reads as open. f33 stays filed, sealed and unrun. A harness fault is retried, struck or voids the run under the entry's rules and is never scored.
rationale: Register f34 organisation_autonomy_replay, which supersedes f33 for the acceptance of promote-referents-without-nudges under design decision 8. Freezes 40 independently authored held-out situations (16 relation, 12 referent, 6 placement, 6 vocabulary freshness; 20 hooked and 20 hookless) and their keys by SHA-256, held in evaluator custody outside the repository. States the arms (main with organisation PR A against the same base plus PR B), one run per arm with a capture and a fresh-recall session, the category-level success and false-precision definitions, the diagnostics, residual blind judging, the Newcombe method-10 paired interval, the merge rule (lower bound above zero and at most one more false-precision situation), fault handling and the run holds. No assertion, operation kind, catastrophic assertion or budget constant changes.
